title: The Arrow Storm
text: Arrows fall from an empty sky over the valley the road must cross, thick as hail, hissing as they come. They stand in the ground like a field of reeds, some fresh, some rotten with age. There are no archers anywhere you can see.

options.label: The one the arrows always find runs ahead to draw them, so the rest may cross.

outcomes.text: They draw every arrow, bristling like a hedgehog, and the rest cross clean behind them.
Too many arrows, too fast. One finds the gap, and it goes deep.

options.label: Walk under shields, slowly, step by step, and endure the hail.

outcomes.text: It takes all day, arrows hammering overhead, and dents every shield. Arms ache for days from holding them up.

options.label: The sharpest eye searches the ridges for the archers, determined to end the storm.

outcomes.text: A ghost archer company on the ridge, still at war, still shooting. They turn as one to face you, and nock.
No one there. The arrows stop when you stop looking for them, and nobody knows why that is worse.
